recoverySizeRamp.note: Recovery placement.h (0.2600) scales a baked foot-anchored size ramp from 0.26 (prone start, held to clip 0.6s) to 0.21 (kneeling end at clip 4.9167s, cubic-smoothstep) in galan-faint-precedent terms.

sourceNote: Ready and Attack are re-ingested from real footage (Tank Attack.mp4, green-dominance keyed) - Ready is a normal-speed ping-pong idle loop, Attack is a two-hit cross-dissolved combo. Defence/Faint/Recovery are built from 12-pose sprite sheets via premultiplied cross-dissolve (optical-flow interpolation was tried first and rejected for ghosting). Faint is trimmed to the first pure (unblended) pose to avoid a double-exposure artifact at the frozen end frame.
revisionHistory: P2 had no animation before 2026-07-22 (static pose image only). Built out to a full five-action system across this session: sprite ingestion, cross-dissolve rebuilds to remove interpolation ghosting, a baked Recovery size ramp, and Attack/Ready re-ingested from real video. Height corrected once (Defence/Faint too small relative to the video actions, fixed by deriving each action's height from its own measured sprite-fill fraction rather than a sibling's).
